info.name: Files middle-click fix
info.summary: Makes middle-click on a file name open it in a new tab in Chrome on Windows
info.description:
Chrome on Windows treats a middle-click on the (scrollable) Files list as the start of autoscroll and never reports the click to Nextcloud, so "open in new tab" silently does nothing.
This app adds one small script to the Files app and public share pages: when the middle button is pressed on a file name or preview, it cancels the browser's default action (autoscroll) so the click reaches Nextcloud as usual. Nothing else is changed.
info.author: MAUN
